'''1997 Tatooine Regionals (Denver)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], one of three in the Tatooine region (New Mexico, Arizona, Nevada, Utah, Colorado).<ref name="nf97tat">[http://www.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/tatooinequalifier.html The Wild Wild West: Stranger Takes Star Wars CCG Denver Title], Rich Loftus, Decipher NewsFlash (6 June 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970607091955/http://www.decipher.com/newsandhighlights/tatooinequalifier.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Andersen, from Salt Lake City, won both games of the final against Chenoweth, the top scorer of the preliminary rounds.<ref name="nf97tat" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Tatooine)
* '''Date:''' 31 May 1997
* '''Site:''' BenCon, Denver, Colorado
* '''Players:''' 26
